rationale: The verified PDF passage states that expanding the ordered perturbed Householder product gives the exact state plus every single-perturbation insertion and an O(u^2) matrix remainder, equivalently Q^T times the sum of F_j plus a second-order remainder. The Lean dependencies implement the same product order, exact normalized Householder matrices, insertion indices, Q convention, and finite sums. Its exact remainder witnesses give a rigorous finite-dimensional interpretation of the paper's informal big-O notation. Both implications hold, the hypotheses are nonvacuous, and no adjudication is needed.
